brief: A two-storey garage tower sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack with tins of screws in it.

requirements.evidence: 6x full bases at 0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0 levels 0 and 1, with snaps, side-connectors on every shared wall, joint bolts and lockJoints; meshClash clear.
Three div2 bins on level 1 dressed with screw/nut heaps (props 1-6, visible from above).

Parts are 3D-printed plastic; configurator checks fit/collisions only, not strength, load, wobble or cracking. Shape helps (compact 3-cell triangle, connectors, joint bolts, lockJoints, caps) but 'never wobble or crack' cannot be guaranteed.
requirements.requirement: Sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack with tins of screws in it

finish.summary: Built compact 2-storey 3-cell tower with divided bins dressed with screws/nuts, joined with side-connectors, joint bolts, lockJoints and caps. Shape aids stability but load/strength/wobble guarantee is beyond what the configurator verifies and depends on user-chosen print material — so that part is unmet.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
